product_one_liner.value: HealthData Platform helps hospitals and health systems extract, convert, archive, and manage patient, employee, and business data, easing work for IT, compliance, HIM, clinical, and revenue-cycle teams.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The Technical archive shows a customer case study rather than at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The linked documentation portal requires a login; anonymous access shows no content and says the visitor does not have access.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists six openings, none titled with an AI, ML, or data-science role covered by the question.

model_provider.notes: The public materials reviewed did not identify a model or model provider; the product documentation portal requires access.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center also lists certifications or standards outside the requested set; only SOC 2 and HIPAA are included here.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile identifies the November 2023 round but does not disclose an amount; the January 2026 Blue Elm transaction was an acquisition, not a funding round for Harmony Healthcare IT.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed funding round was November 2023, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The listed sales openings are titled Associate Business Development Director and Business Development Director, not SDR, BDR, business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest explicit product launch located was ClearWay in June 2025, before the six-month window; later 2026 announcements located concerned a partnership and customer survey, not a product or major feature launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Liddell was appointed CEO effective April 30, 2026; the company also announced Matt Cook as CTO in March 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The active business-development posting names these in its lead-generation and prospecting workflow.
